manual_review: MGBE/RCE CoE and ConnectX RoCE paths distinguished.

HSB PPS clock measurement, metadata clock correlation, SIPL frame threshold and cuVSLAM software matching window separated.
OS1 example explicitly rosbag-only; motion compensation is pose interpolation per point.
GTE to HTE deprecation and Orin-specific application retained.
Source conflicts on Thor VC counts, SIPL CoE/GMSL wording and NITROS terminology retained.
limits: Document/evidence review only, no hardware or robot tests.
visual_review: All 9 figures inspected in contact sheet; PTP message flow, DPLL, PPS measurement setup and oscilloscope figures separately reviewed for correct selection. GMSL diagram 80fps label conflict with 30fps body recorded. Nav2 figure is not claimed to contain an automatic multi-source fusion filter.
